description: Water-demand datasets accompany a real-time forecasting and visualisation toolkit for time series with multiple seasonal patterns. This resource is provided by Jinduan Chen. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The short provider description does not give location, time coverage, sample interval or file format. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
